notes: Baseline seeded manually on 2026-10-21 (first state file for this contract). ath.price_usd is the true all-time high (CoinGecko, 2026-05-28), not the tracking-start price, so the ATH gate cannot false-fire until the token genuinely exceeds it. Targets pre-registered from aeon.yml var so a crossing between runs is caught rather than swallowed by the skill's first-observation rule. h1_pct is stored as null when no trade occurred in the window (DexScreener omits h1 rather than printing 0) - do not read null as 'flat'. Two distinct 'buy' shapes appear on this book and must not be conflated: a single-venue print from a fresh EOA that KEEPS the balance is directional; a same-block sweep of 4-5 pools into one hop then forwarded to a shared sink that ends at 0 balance is arb/aggregator. A third tell, cheaper than decoding receipts: the SAME sender buying in one pool and selling in another within the same second is a two-leg arb. Always balanceOf the receiver before calling an uptick accumulation - and encode balanceOf calldata as selector + 24 hex zeros + the 40-hex address (74 hex chars), never zero-pad the address on the right.
